summary: Verification-of-non-bug: confirmed both reported console messages (Bing CSP violation from main-yEBWDwhV.js, and 'Allow attribute will take precedence over allowfullscreen') do NOT originate from the IFPI app. Both come from the Emergent platform host shell (Vite-based) that iframes the preview URL.

verification_evidence.html_shell: curl of /login shows only <script defer src='/static/js/bundle.js'></script> plus Cloudflare beacon. No main-*.js (Vite naming), no bing/posthog/supabase scripts. CRA (webpack) output is bundle.js, not main-[hash].js.
verification_evidence.bundle_js_grep: 295KB /static/js/bundle.js has 0 matches for bing.com | bat.bing | posthog | supabase | main-yEBW. Only iframes in bundle are webpack-dev-server error-overlay iframes (src='about:blank').

learn_page_iframes.video_line_92: <iframe src={media_url} allowFullScreen title='video' /> -- allowFullScreen ONLY, no allow= attribute
learn_page_iframes.scorm_line_96: <iframe src={media_url} allow='autoplay; fullscreen' title='scorm' /> -- allow= ONLY, no allowFullScreen attribute
learn_page_iframes.conclusion: No iframe in IFPI combines allow AND allowFullScreen on same element, so the Chrome warning cannot originate here.

verification_evidence.runtime_console_capture: Attempted Playwright captures against the preview URL directly (out of iframe). Cloudflare bot-challenge blocked React mount in headless runs (root had 0 children, screenshots blank), so runtime console was empty. This is a preview-only sandbox side-effect and not app behaviour. Static + bundle grep + HTML shell verification provide conclusive evidence.

conclusion: Both console messages originate from the Emergent host page (Vite bundle main-yEBWDwhV.js with Bing/PostHog/Supabase trackers), not from the IFPI app. Main agent's analysis is correct. No code change required.
action_items: None - not an app bug. Optionally advise user to reproduce in the raw preview URL (outside Emergent platform shell) to verify absence of the warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Cloudflare bot-challenge in front of the preview URL blocks headless Playwright from mounting the React app (root remains empty). This is a testing-environment issue, not an app bug, but future testing agents should be aware.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The IFPI CRA bundle is served at /static/js/bundle.js. The reported main-yEBWDwhV.js is the Emergent host shell (Vite). No trackers in IFPI. LearnPage iframes never combine allow+allowFullScreen. Note: Cloudflare bot challenge may block headless Playwright from mounting React; use non-headless or add human-like waits if runtime interaction is needed.
rca of the issue: Report-only CSP violation for bat.bing.com and 'Allow will take precedence over allowfullscreen' warning come from the Emergent platform's own tracking/preview page (Vite bundle main-yEBWDwhV.js) that hosts the app in an iframe. IFPI codebase has zero third-party tracker references and no iframe combines both allow and allowFullScreen attributes. NOT AN IFPI BUG.
